documents.title: Doc 41 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 14 - forced another car off track
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 14 - forced another car off track

details.fact: Car 14 (Stenshorne) forced Car 1 (Camara) off track at Turn 16 on Lap 1.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L Chapter IV, Article 2 (b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 4 points.
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. The Stewards determined that on Lap 1, Car 14 attempted an overtake on the inside of Car 1 at Turn 16, The move was late and optimistic, and the Stewards considered that it was a late dive in. Although Car 14 was fully alongside, it was in that position as a result of the dive in, and hence Car 1 must be left room and Car 14 is not entitled to use the full track width. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards conclude that Car 14 forced Car 1 off the track and Car 1 lost positions. Accordingly, a 10-second time penalty is imposed on Car 14 for forcing another car off the track.

documents.title: Doc 40 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 22 - causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 22 - causing a collision

details.fact: Car 22 (Varrone) made contact with the rear of Car 14 (Stenshorne) at Turn 17.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Five seconds (5) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (a) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 1 point is to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 3 points
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and onboard footage. Approaching Turn 16, Car 22 attempted an overtake on the inside of Car 4. Both cars exited the corner side by side and headed towards Turn 17. At the entry to Turn 17, Car 14 was ahead of them. While Car 14 had other cars ahead fighting for the position, Car 22 continued towards the apex and made contact with the rear of Car 14. As a result of the contact, Car 14 spun, and Car 4 was also involved in the incident. The Stewards determine that Car 22 was wholly responsible for the collision. However, taking into account that the circumstances of the incident were potentially influenced by the reactions of several surrounding cars, the Stewards consider this a mitigating factor and decide to impose a 5-second time penalty rather than the standard 10-second time penalty.

documents.title: Doc 31 - INFRINGEMENT - MP Motorsport - non operational personnel on pit wall
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - MP Motorsport - non operational personnel on pit wall

details.fact: A non operational member of team personnel was reported as seated on a pit wall stand.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 22.12 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A fine of 1000 Euros to be paid by the Competitor. Payment of 500 Euros be made immediately, The remaining 500 Euros are suspended, subject to no similar breach during the 2026 F2 Season In accordance with Article 12.8.1 of the ISC, fines shall be paid within forty‐eight hours of their notification by means of bank transfer to the FIA.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 19) and heard the team representative. They examined photographic evidence and reviewed the Team Operational Declaration. The Team Manager explained that the gentleman involved is a team guest, although this person is registered as non-operational personnel, the Team Manager was unaware that the gentleman had been invited by a member of the F1 Experiences team to occupy a pit wall position that was not operational at the time. He was also provided with a headset from F1 Experiences carrying the live circuit commentary. Having considered all of the available evidence, the Stewards determined that, irrespective of whether the pit wall position was operational, this person, being registered as non-operational personnel, was not permitted to be on the pit wall during a live session. This constitutes a breach of Article 21.12 of the 2026 FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations. The Stewards accepted that there was no intention on the part of the Team to gain any sporting advantage and took into account the particular circumstances of the case, and hence partially suspended the fine.

documents.title: Doc 27 - DECISION - Car 6 - allegedly yellow flag violation in Practice
documents.subject: DECISION - Car 6 - allegedly yellow flag violation in Practice

details.fact: Car 6 (Tsolov) was alleged to have breached yellow flag regulations.
details.infringement: Alleged breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 (b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 14) heard from the Driver of Car 6 (TSO), the team representatives and the FIA Technical Delegate. Together they reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video evidence, timing data and telemetry. During the hearing the driver stated that he was aware of the yellow flag and he lifted the throttle until he saw the green digi panel in front of him (at the exit of Turn 13). The Team provided telemetry evidence taken from the car which was verified with the Technical Delegate as being from the section of the track that was under single yellow at the time. The Stewards determined that the driver entered Turn 12, being the commencement of the yellow flag sector, at a higher speed to his previous and subsequent push laps as he was on an improving lap time. The telemetry confirmed that the driver made a discernible lift increasing from 5% to 20% while within the yellow flag sector, which was also reflected in his speed reduction between the entry to the apex of Turn 13 in comparison to the other push laps. This reduction in speed was higher than on any other push lap. Although the margin of compliance was minimal, the Stewards were satisfied that given the sequence of corners and the amount of the reduction in speed, the driver had reduced speed in response to the yellow flag. Having considered all of the available evidence, the Stewards determined that the driver complied with the requirements of the regulations and that no breach had occurred. Accordingly, no further action is taken. The Stewards emphasise that this decision is based on the specific facts of this case and should not be considered as setting a precedent for future cases.

documents.title: Doc 21 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - breach of Technical Regulation Article 6.3.1 (Fuel sample)
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 11 - breach of Technical Regulation Article 6.3.1 (Fuel sample)

details.fact: Car 11 (Montoya) - the minimum fuel sample of 0.8kg could not be taken from Car 11 at the completion of Practice.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 6.3.1 of the FIA Formula 2 Technical Regulations.
details.decision: Disqualification of Car 11 from the results of the Practice Session. Removal of all times set by Car 11 in the Practice Session. All cars originally classified behind Car 11 are moved up one place in the Practice Session classification.
details.reason: The Stewards received a report from the Technical Delegate (Document 15). They summoned and heard the driver and team representative (document 18). The team representative acknowledged that the minimum required fuel sample of 0.8kgs could not be taken from the Car at the end of the Session. The team representative explained that the team underestimated the fuel consumption. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determine that the Competitor failed to comply with Article 6.3.1 of the FIA Formula 2 Technical Regulations and disqualify Car 11 from the Practice Session.

documents.title: Doc 17 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 25 - impeded Car 6 at T2 in Practice
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 25 - impeded Car 6 at T2 in Practice

details.infringement: Breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Warning given to the driver of Car 25.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 12 & 13) and heard the Drivers of Car 6 (Tsolov) and Car 25 (Bennett) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. Car 25 was on a cool down lap and Car 6 was on a push lap. On the exit of Turn 2, Car 6 caught Car 25 who was on the racing line and exiting the corner slowly. Car 6 was impeded. The Stewards determine that it was unnecessary as Car 25 should have been aware of the possibility of faster car cars approaching and must not be on the racing line unless he is at full speed.

documents.title: Doc 16 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 15 - impeded Car 25 At T16 in Practice
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 15 - impeded Car 25 At T16 in Practice

details.infringement: Breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Warning given to the driver of Car 15.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 10 & 11) and heard the Drivers of Car 15 (Dunne) and Car 25 (Bennett) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. Car 15 was preparing to start a push lap. Car 25 was completing a push lap and caught Car 15 at the entrance to Turn 16 and he was impeded. The Stewards determine that the impeding was unnecessary as Car 15 should be aware of the possibility of being caught in that area and therefore must be at full speed if he is on the racing line. At the hearing the Driver of Car 15 admitted his mistake and the Driver of Car 25 confirmed that the Driver of Car 15 had already apologized to him after the session.
